requirements.title: Data edit descriptors convert data and define/evaluate the corresponding item
requirements.definition: A data edit descriptor converts data to or from internal representation; on successful input the variable becomes defined, and on output the expression is evaluated. A or AT editing can also position formatted stream output.

pending.input-variable-defined: Internal READ(buf,'(I2)') into an integer initially -1 from character(len=2) buf='42' should leave the integer equal to 42 when no error/end condition occurs.
pending.output-expression-evaluated: Internal WRITE(buf,'(I2)') 42 to character(len=2) expects exactly buf='42'.
pending.a-at-stream-positioning-reach: Stream-positioning aspect is deferred to sibling 13.7.4 and clause 12 stream files; no internal-file oracle is asserted.

requirements.title: Unicode input character correspondence restrictions
requirements.definition: During input from a Unicode file, characters corresponding to an ASCII character variable shall have collating positions no greater than 127, and characters corresponding to a default character variable shall be representable as default characters.

pending.unicode-default-character-representabili: Context-dependent source-control plan only: requires a Unicode external file and a character not representable as default character; no portable single-image diagnostic facet is filed here.

requirements.title: Unicode output transmits ISO 10646 characters and has processor-dependent unrepresentable-character results
requirements.definition: During output to a Unicode file, transmitted characters are of ISO 10646 character kind; if a character effective item or character string edit descriptor contains a character not representable as ISO 10646, the result is processor dependent.

review_rationale: Independent fresh-context source review, three rounds: doc/source_audits/batch_137.json. The reviewer re-derived unit hashes and read Tables 13.1, 13.2 and 13.3 ROW BY ROW against the PDF, independently of the author's reconstruction - necessary because extraction interleaved the columns and every future E/EN/ES fixture derives from those rows. THREE blocking findings. The integrator found the first directly: two sample plans gave a NEGATIVE result for the POSITIVE input 0.5, but SS suppresses the optional plus so the sign position must be BLANK - corrected to ' 500.000E-03' and '   5.000E-01', hand-derived and corroborated with gfortran. C137SR-001: ELEVEN units mixing an obligation with a grant of latitude were dispositioned wholly as permission - the fourth occurrence of that class this session - and were re-dispositioned to requirements with the latitude confined to rationale and oracle text; the reviewer confirmed no latitude is now wrongly asserted as an obligation. C137SR-002: placeholder plans remained, saying things like 'future plan must include exact output'; 48 entries were changed, 21 upgraded to exact executable strings and 27 marked explicitly unassertable, and the reviewer independently derived the scale-factor cases -1P,E10.3E2 giving ' 0.010E+02' and 1P,E10.3E2 giving ' 1.000E+00'. R1323 carries no diagnostic facet because it defines a hex-digit-string form and prohibits nothing. Source accounting only: authored_facets unchanged at 1977.
